item.description: ### Fixed - **Perch no longer switches off your other Codex hooks.** Codex remembers which hooks you approved by their position in the list. Perch used to reinstall itself at the bottom, which renumbered everything below it — so a hook you'd approved from another tool quietly stopped running, with nothing to tell you. Perch now keeps its place. - **No more warning in every Codex session.** Perch asked Codex for a five-second window when it finishes a session; Codex allows three, and said so in your terminal every time. It now asks for three.
